$comment: Accepted duplicated lines per file pair, plus generated files whose duplication is the generator's output shape. Each `pairs` value is {"lines": N, "reason": "…"}: the reason is mandatory and says why this duplication stays, or starts with `TODO: ` when it should be extracted and the reason says how. `pnpm check jscpd-frontend` shrink-wraps the numbers, so a reason is the only part written by hand. See `.claude/rules/file-length-allowlist.md`.

apps/desktop/src/lib/servers/S3EndpointF.reason: TODO: the add form's field styles (`.field`, `.field-label`, `.field-help`, `.field-refusal`, `.remedy-row`), which a scoped `<style>` can't share with a child component. `SignInCredentialFields.svelte` carries a third copy. Extract a `lib/ui` form-field primitive (label, control slot, help line, refusal line with its `role="alert"` and id pairing) and render every server form field through it, so the three components drop both the markup pattern and the styles.

apps/desktop/src/lib/file-operations/del.reason: TODO: both components hand-render the same scan readout: the `scan-status` spinner span with its tooltip, the `scan-throughput` row (file rate, a middot separator, byte rate), the `scan-current-dir` line under `useShortenMiddle`, and the CSS for all four classes. Extract a `ScanProgressReadout.svelte` into `lib/file-operations/` beside `TransferProgressReadout.svelte`, taking `scanning`, `scanRate`, `bytesPerSec`, `currentDir`, and an `align` prop for the one real divergence (`justify-content: flex-end` in the delete dialog, `center` in the scan phase), so `DeleteDialog` and `ScanPhaseBody` each render it and drop both the markup and the styles. The umbrella `CLAUDE.md` already names this pattern for the write phase (one dual-bar readout, two surfaces); the scan phase is its twin case.

apps/desktop/src/lib/settings/sections/G.reason: The `<script>` preamble every settings section repeats: seven imports, `interface Props { searchQuery: string }`, the `$props()` destructure, and `shouldShow = $derived(createShouldShow(searchQuery))`. Svelte offers no way to share an import block or a props declaration, so 15 of the 18 lines are the shape the framework and the section contract force, and the markup below them (which rows, which ids, which `anyVisible` list) is entirely per-section. The one shareable line is `defaultDef`, which would fold into a `settingDef(id)` helper in `$lib/settings` returning the empty-label fallback; worth doing on its own merits, though it moves this count by one line.
